mechanism: Ethambutol can cause peripheral neuropathy and CNS effects (including seizures, confusion, and psychosis) which may complicate seizure management and increase CNS adverse effects when combined with levetiracetam.
action: Monitor patients for worsening seizure control, peripheral neuropathy, and CNS symptoms; assess need for alternative tuberculosis therapy if feasible or increased levetiracetam dosing; consider baseline and periodic ophthalmologic and neurologic assessments.
